generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Total value of civil engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
Conditional Tenders will not be accepted
Tenderer shall note that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation
All materials required for this work shall be procured by the Tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP- portal

The tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate of any nature workdone certificate 25% of amount put to tender in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of Bids for physical verification
The Project Completion Period is 03 Months including rainy season
The defect liability period is 1 years from the date of completion of work failing which action will be taken as per tender condition

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx5-B) where A is equal to Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2024-25 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited 0.25 Year B Value at 2025-26 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.25 Year form the probable date of Award of this contract

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Any Civil workdone certificate 25 percent of amount put tender from competent authorities.

The contractor has to upload turnover certificate 2020-21 to 2024-25 of the previous 5 financial years duly certified by the charted accountant/Auditor under his seal and signature of which turnover of any one year shall be more than amount put to tender for the purpose of evaluating tender capacity
Contractors must upload B- Value details of ongoing works being executed by the contractor

Annual Financial statements containing receipts and payments accounts, profit and loss account, Balance sheet and annual returns filing statement prepared and signed by the charted accountant or auditor under their seal
The contractors must upload the schedule Caste certificate issued by the Revenue authorities failing which the tender will be rejected

The schedule Caste contractors must submit residential certificate for residing in Karnataka issued by the Revenue authorities failing which the tender will be rejectedissued by the Revenue authorities failing which the tender will be rejected
